# Tuteliq React Native SDK

> Official React Native SDK for Tuteliq, the AI-powered child safety API, with a provider and React hooks for mobile apps.

## What is this?
A React Native library for the Tuteliq child safety API. Detect bullying, grooming, self-harm, fraud and other harmful content with React hooks. Works on iOS and Android. It wraps the Tuteliq Node SDK (@tuteliq/sdk) and re-exports all of its client, enums, errors and types.

## Install
npm install @tuteliq/react-native

## Quick Start
import { TuteliqProvider, useAnalyze, isActionable } from '@tuteliq/react-native'

// Wrap the app once
<TuteliqProvider apiKey="your-api-key" options={{ timeout: 30000, retries: 3 }}>
  <App />
</TuteliqProvider>

// In a component
const { execute, loading } = useAnalyze()
const result = await execute({ content: 'content to check' })
if (isActionable(result.recommended_action)) { /* hold the message for review */ }

## Key Features
- A useX() hook for each detection, media, verification, incident, webhook, usage and privacy method, each returning { data, loading, error, execute, reset }
- useTuteliqClient() for direct access to every client method
- iOS and Android support
- Safety, fraud and harm detection with age group calibration
- Synthetic content detection for text, image, audio and video
- Session-based age and identity verification (useCreateVerificationSession, useGetVerificationSession)
- Incident listing and moderator review
- TypeScript support

## Supported Languages
32 languages: English (stable), Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Italian, Turkish, Romanian, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Slovenian, Maltese, Irish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian (beta). Auto-detected, no configuration needed.
